notes.title: Bug fix, v. 2.0.11
Update 2.0: Kingslayer
notes.notes:
Hello!

We continue to improve our project, the new add-on includes:
- The final boss, King Mushroom. The swordsman boss, who seeks to engage in close combat with the hero, is the summoner of the horde and the mentor of the other bosses who guard his chambers. He can break through the character's shield and has his own arena for battle.
- Speedrun mode. Upon the destruction of the final boss, the game ends.
- Difficulty change. Now the difficulty is evenly divided into different zones, upon opening which both the spawn rate of mushrooms and their variety will be increased.
- Two new opponents: a locker and a thief. Both affect active seals, and both will affect the game in the late stages of the game.
- Gambling. Mr. Dep enters the game and provides an opportunity to get valuable items for the run for a small fee in souls. Appears every minute near the character.

Enjoy the game and successful runs!

notes.title: Small fix, v. 1.2.10
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are fixing some game difficults:
- Seals open in portions
- Horde now spawns mobs almost simultaneously
- Big mush and snipers start spawning after 4 minutes if the player hasn't opened any location

notes.title: Major update, v. 1.2.8
notes.notes:
Hello!

In the new update, we have reworked the balance, now the runs have become much easier at the beginning and do not lose momentum as you progress! Also:
- The difficulty now increases linearly, new enemies are unlocked along with new locations. Move on to new stages when you are ready!
- A difficulty scale has appeared. Now the game level can be seen right in the game
- The crafting system has been removed. In its place is now a system for upgrading seals. Extra seals can be processed into materials for their improvement
- The rules for working with seals have been updated. Now, when selecting a stronger seal, it will replace a weaker seal from the active ones if there is no room for new ones
- The fighter has been redrawn. Now he stands out from other mushrooms
- The training has been modified, a block with seals has been added. The seals themselves now display their type

Among the innovations:
- A horde state has been added. After a while, many mushrooms will spawn around you, which must be exterminated in the allotted time.  During this time, the main spawn is disabled. If you don't make it, some of the seals in your inventory and in the seal circle will be destroyed!

The next major update will add a hidden enemy that controls the horde and confronts you with renewed vigor. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Small fix, v. 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello!

A small update:
- Added endless mode: an additional option when starting a run, disabling control over exceeding the mushroom limit on the level and eliminating mushrooms (except bosses) 30 seconds after their appearance. The run ends only when the character dies
- Fixed the error in choosing the spawn location of mushrooms

notes.title: Slashboy is available!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Finally, the full version of Slashboy is published!
In the full and updated version you will find:
- Updated map, which has become a little larger, with auto-jump zones
- Achievements, your efforts will not go unnoticed
- 4 bosses with unique rules and 19 seals for different styles (and then more)
- Separate setting of the spawn speed of opponents. Find your pace
- Mini-story about a lonely samurai
- Unusual gaming experience of high-speed extermination of opponents

Compete and beat your own records!

notes.title: Fest - Next!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are participating in the "Next Fest" festival, and we invite you to try out the demo version before the game itself is published.

The demo version shows the basic mechanics of the game, an incomplete set of skills and a tutorial designed to tell you a little more about the game.

Try a new arcade experience!

notes.title: Demo: Training for Beginners
notes.notes:
Hi, friends!

We are happy to announce that a tutorial has been added to the demo version of the game!

You can download the demo and try chopping mushrooms right now! If this is your first visit, the tutorial will be launched automatically in the first run. And for a repeat run, you can go straight to the tutorial map in the main menu.

notes.title: Demo published!
notes.notes:
Hooray!

We are happy to announce that the demo version of the game is published and ready for use!

You can download the demo and try slicing mushrooms right now! If you have any ideas or suggestions, write to us by email or create a topic in the discussions, we will be glad to hear fresh ideas!

PunchGameProject Team
